name: step side panel timing — PB-0008 POST-DEPLOY (feature-0003 / 20260814T1830-step-panel-timing)

steps.script: (() => { const n = window.__pbZoom('폭 300px (최소 · 리사이저 클램프)'); if (!n) throw new Error('PB0008 FAIL: 확대 복제 실패'); return JSON.stringify({ zoomedTimes: n }); })()

(() => { if (window.__pbRestore) window.__pbRestore(); document.querySelectorAll('#pb-steptiming-zoom').forEach((n) => n.remove()); try { localStorage.setItem('web.stepSidePanel.width', '340'); } catch (e) {} return 'restored'; })()
